annotations.title: Incremental feed: items newer than the id you already have (cursor polling)

description:
Incremental feed: items newer than the id you already have (cursor polling). All stored items with id > id (oldest first, up to limit 1-100, default 50) plus next_id/has_more for the next call. The cheapest way for a bot to poll without duplicates: keep next_id and pass it back.

GET /news/since — price $0.002 USDC per call, paid automatically via x402 on Base (only successful responses are charged; 400/404/502 are free).

id.description: Last item id you already have (0 = from the oldest stored item). Items with a larger id are returned, oldest first.

limit.description: Max items per page (default 50, max 100) Default: 50.

name: get_news_since
